text.p: World number one Steffi Graf overcame a hesitant start to power into the last 16 of the Australian Open with a straight sets victory over Argentina's Ines Gorrochategui on Friday.
Graf, who is attempting to win her seventh successive grand slam title, trailed 0-3 in the opening set before storming back to take the match 7-5 6-3.
The German failed to find her forehand range against Gorrochategui in the early stages, but regained her composure and won 20 of the last 22 points to take the first set in 38 minutes.
Graf will meet either 12th seed Amanda Coetzer of South Africa or Spanish qualifier Maria Luisa Serna in her next match.
